input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) even when help is None, and the caller no longer substitutes an empty string. The docstring promises an empty description, but the code passes None through.
- rationale: Trigger: a command with one documented Argument and one undocumented Argument, so format_options takes the branch that writes the section. Mechanism: the undocumented argument yields (metavar, None), and HelpFormatter.measure_table calls term_len on that None, which fails inside strip_ansi with a TypeError. Impact: --help crashes for any command that mixes documented and undocumented positional arguments, which is a common case.
critique: The finding identifies the same mechanism: get_help_record returns (metavar, None) for an undocumented argument, and the caller no longer substitutes an empty string. Measuring and writing that None in the help table then raises a TypeError when a command mixes documented and undocumented arguments. It names format_options rather than format_arguments, but the faulty operation and failure path are the same.
